scope: Read-only mesh, normal/tangent and collar UV/albedo analysis. Existing images inspected; no new rendering, engine process, asset mutation or paid generation.

tools.execution: --background --factory-startup -t 4 --python-expr; imported into disposable in-memory scenes only
tools.other: Python standard-library GLB parsing and SHA256; Blender NumPy for read-only atlas pixel sampling

mesh_normal_analysis.method: Import GLB/FBX separately, set armature REST, transform positions/normals to Blender world space; compare per-face corner-normal angles and smooth flags.
mesh_normal_analysis.flat_test: Every corner normal has dot product >0.999999 against the first corner normal.
mesh_normal_analysis.conclusion: FBX is not globally flat shaded; GLB and FBX retain very similar authored corner normals. Smooth polygon flags alone do not establish continuity across split vertices.

tangent_analysis.method: Read GLB POSITION/NORMAL/TANGENT/TEXCOORD_0 streams. Convert glTF axes to Blender axes, match loops by world position and UV rounded to five decimals, then compare supplied normalized tangents/normals against Blender calc_tangents Mikk output.
tangent_analysis.limitations: Rounded position/UV keys may collide at hard edges; unmatched loops and outliers are not resolved. This is CPU basis agreement, not a measurement of the saved Unreal render buffer.
tangent_analysis.conclusion: No demonstrated widespread GLB-to-FBX tangent corruption; importing alternate tangents is not yet justified.

normal_texture_analysis.method: Read GLB image bufferView referenced by material.normalTexture; compare embedded PNG bytes against retained normal.png.
normal_texture_analysis.cpu_review_setup: Retained FBX CPU review uses full mapped normals. Different lighting prevents treating existing CPU/native images as a controlled A/B.
normal_texture_analysis.hypothesis: Attenuating the new normal map may expose coarse surface or authored split-normal artifacts that the full map compensates. A controlled normal-strength A/B is required; this is not a proven final fix.

central_skin_neck_split_normals.method: Group corner normals at world positions rounded to five decimals. Include faces whose sampled base-color centroid passes the stated skin-color heuristic; restrict sampled positions to the central front neck.
central_skin_neck_split_normals.skin_color_heuristic: R>0.25 and R>1.2*B and R>1.08*G; normalized RGB sampled from retained atlas.
central_skin_neck_split_normals.limitations: Color heuristic is not semantic segmentation. Coincident geometry/intersections may contribute to large angular outliers; no global normal recomputation is warranted from this statistic alone.
central_skin_neck_split_normals.conclusion: Substantial authored split-normal disagreement is present in the selected skin region and can contribute to triangular shading.

collar_analysis.method: Count geometric boundary edges after position welding at 1e-5m; sample retained base-color PNG at triangle centroids and geometric edge-midpoint UVs using nearest pixels.
collar_analysis.conclusion: A pale jagged collar rim predates the comic filter and has a source UV/albedo boundary contribution: dark garment faces sample pale skin at their edge. No open hole was found in the tested region.
collar_analysis.limitations: No full-model watertightness claim. Nearest-pixel sampling is not GPU bilinear sampling, and the source texture contribution does not exclude normal/lighting contributions.

bounded_next_step: Root-controlled same-mesh/same-light native closeup A/B of 35% versus full mapped normals, preserving old material/source evidence. If rim persists, diagnose a separate local collar UV/albedo or narrow trim correction. No blind green-channel flip or global normal recomputation.
